content:
作者对视频的介绍：
“This is my present to you guys. Thanks for everything !
I'm aware that it doesn't beat INC2 but that was not my intention.
I just hope its a worthy sequel and you will enjoy watching it :)”
Incorporated 2的制作确实太精良了 (其中一些demo问题算是仅有的瑕疵吧)
“clayman is the only person who can mix 2 different songs together to sound like﻿ the same song and sound better than the 2 on their own”INC2其中一首BGM下面的评论
另外INC3这些Demo都是从线下比赛里来的
